text_block_list.text:
Though defeated by El Condor Pasa, the 
experience lit a fire in Special Week's 
heart.

Vowing to each other to become even 
stronger, Special Week and the others left 
the racecourse behind.

However, on the way home, Grass Wonder 
appears and asks for a duel to settle 
things once and for all.

And so, Special Week sets off to face the 
"Monster," Grass Wonder, at the Arima 
Kinen...!
